description: Four-portal X-junction with two staging hubs in the middle. A WEST hub (krgk19) gathers traffic from the west, north, and a NW dead-end pocket; a CENTRAL hub area (yumvdc + l9phbl + 28p0rn) gathers traffic from the south and east arms. The two hubs are richly interconnected, so cross-portal routing through the center has multiple equivalent paths. Each portal arm has its own short staging anchor to keep the legs axis-aligned.

traversalNotes: FOUR-PORTAL X-JUNCTION with TWO interconnected hubs:
WEST HUB (west_hub) gathers west + north + NW-pocket traffic.

CENTRAL HUB (center / sw_inner / nw_inner / se_inner) gathers south + east traffic. The two hubs are linked via several edges (e.g. west_hub ↔ sw_inner, west_hub ↔ se_inner) so cross-portal routes have alternate paths.
Direct routes through the X (picking the canonical hop sequence; alternates exist via the hub edges):
west ↔ east:  spawn_west → west_hub → sw_inner → east_mid → east_inner → spawn_east.
west ↔ south: spawn_west → west_hub → south_inner → spawn_south.
west ↔ north: spawn_west → west_hub → north_inner → spawn_north.
north ↔ south: spawn_north → north_inner → west_hub → south_inner → spawn_south (or via nw_inner → center → sw_inner → south_inner).
north ↔ east:  spawn_north → north_inner → sw_inner → east_mid → east_inner → spawn_east.
south ↔ east:  spawn_south → south_inner → east_mid → east_inner → spawn_east.

DISPATCH RULE: nw_pocket is the obvious dead-end detour for objectives — reach via west_hub. Other 'interior' anchors (center, nw_inner, sw_inner, se_inner) are transit-only; dispatch via the arm-end staging anchors (north_inner, south_inner, east_inner) for arm-side objectives.
Multiple equivalent routes between hubs — the solver can pick whichever stays axis-aligned. Don't emit cross-arm diagonals.
Stages are never physically rotated — all positions are stage-local mesh-space XZ.
